title: The cardiac cycle: pressures, volume, and valves
concept: Relate the four phases of the left-ventricular cycle to valve opening/closing and to the Wiggers pressure-volume tracings.

storyboard.caption: Mitral valve closes (S1). Pressure rises, volume constant.
Aortic valve opens. Blood ejected, volume falls.
Aortic valve closes (S2). Pressure falls, volume constant.
Mitral valve opens. Ventricle fills at low pressure.
